notes.title: CLeM Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It’s been almost 2 years since we revealed CLeM, the fourth game in the Psychotic Adventures series, to the world. Now, we're thrilled to announce that the game is set to release on February 6th, 2024! 

To mark this occasion, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer that’ll take you into the mystical world of CLeM! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=BuiYImHSR9o;full]https://youtu.be/BuiYImHSR9o[/previewyoutube]

We’ve also decided on a price point for the game: $15.99. In addition, we’ll be adding a 10% discount on launch day!

We want to send a massive, heartfelt thank you to all those who’ve been following and supporting CLeM up to this point! As we close in on the crucial release phase that will determine CLeM's success, we invite you to join our Discord and contribute to making it as successful as possible!

We hope that you are as excited about the imminent release of CLeM as we are! 

Wishlist the game now!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: Update 07: Introducing Agatha Knife and Colossus Down, our next Psychotic Adventures
notes.notes:
As many of you may already know, we are working on our next Psychotic Adventures. 

In Agatha Knife, to be released this year, you will join the little butcher in the creation of Carnivorism, her own religion. In this new point and click adventure you'll learn about Agatha's story, one of the most beloved characters of MechaNika. 

We are also working on MechaNika's sequel (codename Colossus Down), but right now we are just prototyping some ideas, so there's still a lot of work to do. It will be a beat'em up with some really nice features that we'll announce in the near future.

Anyway, you can take a look at these new stories in our new video and if you want to learn more about how we progress in the development of the new Psychotic Adventures follow us on Twitter or Facebook. We'll be posting about it!

notes.title: Update 05: New cursor size option
notes.notes:
Hey psychotics!

We've added a new option on MechaNika so now you can change the game cursor. You may want to do that because 

A) you don't like our awesome big cursor and you prefer your system's 

and/or 

B) you are having issues while trying to control the cursor.

In any case, you can now toggle the cursor style in the options menu. If you are not able to do that because B, then just open the game preferences file (you can find it in %UserProfile%/.prefs/ on Windows or in ~/.prefs/ on Linux and OS) and change the value of the CURSOR SIZE attribute from BIG to SMALL.

If you have any doubt or new issue, feel free to contact us and we'll try to do our best!


Have fun!

notes.title: Update 03: New display resolution and fullscreen options
notes.notes:
After dealing with some issues related to display resolutions and knowing that some of you'd like to have an option to play MechaNika on windowed mode we have added two new options, so now you can change the game resolution to one that properly fits your display and toggle the fullscreen mode.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9364118/9fa5363b6e0b08ab8476c7ea2e796856eeed197a.jpg

Clicking on the display resolution button (the yellow one) the game will be configured in the next available resolution. You can click many times until MechaNika fits your display. These are the defined resolutions:

1280 x 720
1280 x 800
1366 x 768
1440 x 900
1600 x 900
1680 x 1050
1920 x 1080
1920 x 1200
2560 x 1440

In case you want to specify a different resolution, open the mechanika-preferences file (you can find it in %UserProfile%/.prefs/ on Windows or in ~/.prefs/ on Linux and OS) and you'll be able to specify your preferred display size there (you'll need to start the game after being updated so these new options appear in the preferences file).

Clicking on the fullscreen button (the purple one) will toggle the fullscreen mode, obviously.

We hope that these two new options are useful to those that had problems with the game resolution!

notes.title: Update 01: MechaNika has been released!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

A month ago MechaNika was greenlit on Steam and now it has been released for PC and Mac. YAY!

https://s7.postimg.org/soqt2l37f/mechanika_on_steam.gif

For those who don't know about the game, MechaNika is the first episode of what we call the Psychotic Adventures, games that take place in the Psychotic world. This first episode features Nika, a smart 7 year old girl that doesn't like this world, so she wants to destroy it. A charming girl, isn't she? She has a plan to achieve her goal: a massive destruction weapon called MechaNika, but first she needs to find the remaining components so she can complete and assemble her invention. You will join her in her quest to find these components while you meet more Psychotic characters, like Marcus the meal dealer, Rosemary the almost blind and deaf video game addict granny, and Agatha the Carnivorist. 

We won't tell you anymore because we want you to play the game and discover the story with all the details we've put in it. We hope you really enjoy it! We'd like to know what you think about it, what you love, what you hate, your favorite character, anything you'd change to improve the game, etc. We are already working on new Psychotic Adventures, so your feedback is really important to us.

By the way, we know that many people don't like the font that is depicted in the launch trailer and in the screenshots. Don't panic! You can choose a different font, more readable, if you want. Check it out in this video.

https://s7.postimg.org/v62k9vpor/mechanika_intro_fonts.gif

And one last note: bear in mind that MechaNika is not a game for kids, not because it has a cartoon pussy on it or because Nika takes a swig of her cognac and cocoa shake when she needs to see things clearer, but because they won't probably understand the story or the jokes. Despite its naïve visuals, the game exposes some adult themes, always from a fun perspective, of course.

And... that's it! Nothing more to say. So thanks for your support and don't hesitate to post any comment, review or doubt you have on the community hub. Have fun!
